title: Depths of children of a shallow gate
statement: Let $m\in\mathbb N$, choose an AND or OR gate, and let $cs$ be a list of Boolean circuit trees on $m$ variables. If the circuit formed by applying that gate to the children in $cs$ has depth at most $1$, then every child in $cs$ has depth $0$.
hypotheses_covered: Gate type is AND or OR
List cs of circuit trees on m variables
The circuit formed from the gate and cs has depth at most 1
replaced:
Let $C$ be the Boolean circuit consisting of a single gate (an AND gate or an OR gate,
according to a flag $\mathit{isAnd}$) applied to a list $cs$ of child circuits, so that
the depth of $C$ equals $1$ plus the maximum depth among the circuits in $cs$. If the
depth of $C$ is at most $1$, then every child circuit $c \in cs$ has depth $0$; that is,
each child is a literal.
